Tommy\'s essay

\n\n\n\t In just a few moments, both Tommy\'s mother and father, recently separated, will attend a parent-teacher conference about his failing grades and destructive behavior. However, neither of them knew that they were invited at the same time.
Tommy, their only son, was always happy, obedient, and an excellent student. Now, I don\'t know how to tell Tommy\'s parents that the boy\'s recent decline in academic performance is the reaction of a child who is suffering too much pain in his heart from the separation and his parents\' impending divorce.
Tommy\'s mother entered the room and sat down in the chair I had placed near my table. Then Tommy\'s father also arrived. Both intentionally ignored each other.
When I showed them the detailed results of Tommy\'s moral and academic behavior, I secretly hoped to think of a way that could help both of them come closer together and understand that what they did had an impact. to what the boy is like. However, for some reason I couldn\'t say anything. Perhaps one of those sloppy, smeared pieces of paper that Tommy had written would help them understand that?
I found that crumpled, tear-soaked piece of paper stuffed in Tommy\'s desk drawer.
Scribbled, repetitive lines covered both sides of the paper.
I gently smoothed the piece of paper and gave it to Tommy\'s mother. She read it and gave it to her husband without saying a word. Tommy\'s father frowned. But then, his face relaxed. Time seemed to stand still as he silently read and reread his child\'s scribbled words.
Finally, he carefully folded the piece of paper and reached out to hold his wife\'s hand. She wiped the remaining tears from her eyes and smiled at him. My eyes were also filled with tears, but no one seemed to notice that.
God showed me how to unite Tommy\'s family. The person who helped me find the piece of paper covered with words written from the boy\'s heavy heart:
“Dear Dad…Dear Mom…I love you both…I love you both…I love you both…”
Little girl Almie Rose

\n\n\n\t It was two months before Christmas when our nine-year-old daughter Almie Rose said she wanted a new bike. But near Christmas, it seemed she forgot that wish.
We bought her a Nanny doll set - a very popular toy, along with a doll house. However, contrary to our thoughts, two days before Christmas, Almie Rose still expressed that she liked the bicycle more than any other toy in the world.
It was too late, with hundreds of things to prepare for the Christmas party and buying last-minute gifts, we didn\'t have time to choose the right bike for Almie Rose. So, at 9pm on Christmas Eve, when Almie Rose and her six-year-old brother Dylan were curled up peacefully in their blankets, both my husband and I were still awake because of our daughter\'s wishes. We feel guilty for disappointing our children.
“How about I shape a bicycle out of clay and write a note saying: you will be able to exchange this clay bicycle for a real bicycle?” my husband suggested. Maybe that\'s a good way, because bicycles are quite a difficult item to buy, and the girl is also an "adult" who no longer nags for gifts. So, my husband worked hard for four hours to mold a miniature bicycle.
On Christmas morning, we were really anxiously waiting for the moment Almie Rose opened a small heart-shaped gift with a white and red clay bicycle inside. Finally, it was time for her to open her gift and read aloud the note I had written.
“Is it true that I can use this bicycle that dad made in exchange for a real one, Mom?”
“That\'s right, honey!” I smiled brightly.
Tears sparkled in the corners of Almie Rose\'s eyes as she answered:
“I will never trade the bike that dad made for me. I would rather keep this car than exchange it for a real car.”
At that time, we felt so happy that we could go to the ends of the earth to buy our daughter any bicycle in the world.
Hand

\n\n\n\t On Thanksgiving day, a first grade teacher asked her students to draw a picture of what they felt grateful for. She wanted to know what these poor children were truly grateful for.
She figured most of her students would draw pictures of turkeys or tables filled with food. However, she was extremely surprised to see a picture of the boy Douglas with a picture of a hand drawn in a simple and innocent way.
Why did Douglas draw hands? And whose hand is this? The whole class was fascinated by Douglas\' painting.
“I think it must be the hand of God, who brought us food,” said one boy.
“That\'s a farmer\'s hand,” said another boy, “because he raises turkeys.”
Finally, when the other students were focused on their work, the teacher leaned over Douglas\'s desk and asked him whose hand it was. “That\'s your hand, miss,” the boy whispered.
This reminded her that during breaks, she often held Douglas\'s hand. She often does that with other students. But to Douglas - a lonely and quiet child - this was extremely meaningful. Perhaps this is Thanksgiving for everyone, not for the material things we receive, but for the things, no matter how small, when we give to others.
Place to return

\n\n\n\t An orphan girl lives with her grandmother in a small room upstairs. One night, the house suddenly caught fire and the grandmother died while trying to save her granddaughter. The fire spread quickly, and the entire ground floor of the house was quickly engulfed in flames.
The neighbors called the fire department, then stood there looking helplessly, unable to rush into the house because the fire had blocked all entrances. The girl desperately cried for help at the upstairs window. At that time, there were rumors in the crowd that the firefighters would arrive a few minutes late because they were busy fighting fires elsewhere.
Suddenly, a man appeared with a ladder. He leaned the ladder against the wall of the house, then quickly went inside. And he came back with the little girl in his arms. He handed the girl to the people waiting with open arms below and then disappeared into the night.
Everyone investigated and found that the girl had no relatives left. A few weeks later, a meeting was held to decide who would care for and raise the girl.
A teacher wanted to adopt the girl. She gave the reason that she could guarantee her child a good education. A farmer took care of the girl because he thought she would be healthy and comfortable living on the farm. Others also gave favorable reasons for adopting her. Finally, one of the richest people in town stood up and said:
“I can give this girl all the favorable conditions you just mentioned, plus money and all that money can buy.”
During the discussion, the girl remained silent, looking at the floor.
“Does anyone else have any other opinions?” the chairman spoke up.
A man from the back of the room stepped forward. His steps were slow and painful. When he arrived in front of everyone, he walked straight to the girl and held out his hands. Everyone was extremely surprised. His hands and both arms were severely burned.
The girl burst into tears:
“This is the person who saved me!”
Then she threw her arms around the man\'s neck, as if holding on for dear life, as she did that fateful night. Then the girl put her head on the man\'s shoulder and sobbed for a moment. Then I looked up and smiled at him. “This is the end of the meeting,” the chairman announced.
What we don\'t say

\n\n\n\t My son Joey was born with a birth defect in his leg. The doctors assured us that after treatment the boy would be able to walk normally, but running and jumping would be very difficult.
During the first three years of his life, Joey had to undergo countless splinting and bandaging surgeries. When he was eight years old, when he watched Joey walk, you couldn\'t tell there was a problem with his feet.
Like many children his age, Joey loves to run and jump and often plays tag with his friends without hesitation. We didn\'t tell him that he might never be able to run like the other kids. So, my son doesn\'t know that.
In seventh grade, Joey decided to join the school\'s cross country team. Every day, he practices with the team. Joey is the one who trains harder and runs more than any other member of the team – perhaps because he feels that while running comes naturally to everyone, it is a The problem is a bit difficult for me.
Although the entire team participated in practice, only a group of 7 best people capable of bringing victory to the school were selected to compete. We didn\'t tell Joey that he was unlikely to be in that top group. So, my son doesn\'t know that.
Joey regularly ran four to five miles every day, even when he was tormented by a fever of 39 degrees Celsius. That day, I was very worried, so I decided to go to school during running practice after school to find my child. When I arrived, I saw that Joey was alone on the track. When I asked, the boy simply said: "I\'m fine!" He still has two more miles to run to complete today\'s run.
Drops of sweat poured down my son\'s face and his eyes seemed completely blurry from fever. However, Joey still looked straight ahead and continued running. We never said he couldn\'t run four miles with a high fever. So, my son doesn\'t know that.
Two weeks later, the names of the members selected for the cross country team were announced. Joey is sixth on the list. My son was on the team. He is the only seventh grader – while the other members are all eighth graders. We never told our child he wouldn\'t be able to do it. And because we never said it… Joey didn\'t know. It just knows how to try its best.
"Only time is enough to grind an inanimate stone into a shimmering pearl, only time is enough to transform a mediocre person into a great man. And only time can prove the truest values.”
A person who is always optimistic

\n\n\n\t We are blessed with three wonderful boys. The middle son, Billy, is nicknamed “The Always Optimist.” He is always the first to wake up, running into his parents\' bed at 5 am.
Even though we reminded him to keep quiet and go back to sleep, he always whispered angrily: "The weather will be beautiful this morning." I can hear the birds singing outside!” When we told Billy to be quiet, he replied: "I\'m not telling my parents, I\'m talking to myself!"
At kindergarten, the teacher let the whole class draw a picture of a tiger. Billy has no talent for painting, and his tiger has one eye closed and one eye open. When the teacher asked why the tiger cub closed one eye, Billy replied, “Because the tiger was saying, ‘I\'m looking at you, boy!\'”
One time, he argued with his brother about whether the man on television was really bald. “He\'s not bald,” Billy said. He\'s only bald when he looks at you. When he left, he had a lot of hair!”
Our youngest son developed a serious kidney disease on a Tuesday, and died that same Friday. The evening after Tanner\'s funeral, I lay next to Billy to chat as usual. That night, mother and child lay in the dark without saying much. Suddenly, Billy said to me: "I\'m very sad for what happened to our family, but I\'m even more sad for many other people." Which other people is the boy talking about? “Those are people who never knew Tanner. Aren\'t our whole family so lucky to have had Tanner for 20 months? Look mom, there are many people who never have the luck to see me. My family is truly lucky people.”
Things engraved in me

\n\n\n\t One day, while sitting in a quiet room waiting for an appointment, suddenly a strange feeling arose within me. I quickly checked to make sure I was awake and not dreaming, and I found myself farther away than any dream could have been.
Every thought I have is like a drop of water falling into a still lake, and I am amazed at the peace of each passing moment.
Then suddenly, my mother\'s face appeared - her face before the terrible Alzheimer\'s disease caused her to lose all memory, not be able to feel people, and lose more than 22 pounds. Her beautiful silver hair curled around her delicate face. She looked so real and close that I felt like I could reach out and touch her. I even smelled Joy perfume - my mother\'s favorite perfume. It seemed like she was waiting for something and didn\'t say anything.
“Mom, I\'m so sorry you had to endure that terrible disease!” I say.
She shook her head slightly, as if she understood what I was talking about the suffering she had gone through. Then she smiled - a very affectionate smile - and said clearly: "But what I remember is only your love!". Having said that, she disappeared.
I shivered as the room suddenly became cold, and I knew clearly that only the love we give and receive is all we remember. All pain will pass, only love will remain forever.
My mother\'s words were the most precious things I have ever heard, and that moment is forever engraved in my heart.
True love

\n\n\n\t Moses Mendelssohn, grandfather of the famous German composer, was a very ugly-looking man. In addition to being short in stature, he was also hunchbacked.
One day he visited a merchant in Hamburg who had a very lovely daughter named Frumtje. As soon as he met Frumtje, Moses fell passionately in love with her but despaired because she appeared afraid of his ugly appearance.
When it was time to leave, Moses mustered up the courage to go upstairs to the girl\'s room, hoping to have one last chance to talk to her. To him, she was the embodiment of angelic beauty, but she made him sad by avoiding looking at him. After trying to have a few pleasantries, Moses confusedly asked her, “do you believe that marriage is something that was decided in a previous life in heaven?”
“I believe,” the girl answered him, still looking at the floor – “and do you believe too?”
“Yes, I believe so,” he replied. “You know. In heaven every time a boy is born, God tells him about the girl he will marry. When I was born, my future bride was also appointed. God also said that my wife would become a hunchback. At that moment I cried out “Oh my God! A hunchback woman would be a tragedy! Sir, please give me that hump so that my wife can be beautiful."
Frumtje looked up into his eyes and for a moment there was a violent disturbance in her mind. She reached out and gave Moses her hand, and then became his devoted wife.
In love there is always a paradox: Two people are one but still two.
Red hat angel

\n\n\n\t Sitting alone in a coffee shop, I felt very scared. Tomorrow, I have to undergo a spinal surgery. The possibility of risk is huge, but I still try to cling to faith. “God, please send me an angel to help me overcome tomorrow\'s test!” I whispered pleadingly.
When I looked up and was about to leave the shop, I saw an elderly woman slowly walking closer to the cash register. I stood next to her, silently admiring the elegant, fashionable dress with red and purple flower petals that she was wearing, as well as the scarf, pin, and striking burgundy hat. “Sorry ma\'am, you are truly a beautiful woman!” I blurted out.
She held my hand lovingly and said: “Daughter, I thank you very much. I have a prosthetic arm, and the other arm is also in an iron brace. And this leg is not real either. It takes a lot of time to change clothes. I always try my best, but it\'s been so long that I\'ve gotten used to it. You made me feel so happy. May God always watch over you and bless you!” Watching her leave, I suddenly felt relieved. She is truly an angel that God sent to me.
“By faith, you can see even the invisible.”
Source of encouragement

\n\n\n\t Some of the greatest success stories in history stemmed from a word of encouragement and trust from a lover or a trusted friend.
If it weren\'t for a wife with strong beliefs like Sophia, we probably wouldn\'t have found the name Nathaniel Hawthorne among the great names of American literature.
When a heartbroken Nathaniel returned home and told his wife that he had just lost his job, her joyful attitude surprised him:
“Now I have time to write a book!” she said happily.
"I know!" he replied not very confidently. “But how will we live while you sit and write?”
To her husband\'s surprise, Sophia opened the drawer and took out a considerable amount of money.
“Where did you get that money?” he exclaimed.
“I always knew you were a genius,” she said. “I know that one day you will write a masterpiece. So, every week I kept a little of the money you gave me from the market. This place is enough for us to live for a year.”
With his wife\'s trust and expectations, one of the greatest novels of American literature was born, the novel: "The Red Letter A".
“It doesn\'t take much to make others happy. Just a gesture if you know how, just a word at the right time… just a small adjustment to a pin, a screw or a screw in the delicate machine of your soul.”
Boundless happiness

\n\n\n\t There is boundless happiness in bringing happiness to others regardless of your own circumstances. Suffering shared will be halved, but happiness shared will be doubled.
\n\t Two men were seriously ill and were placed in the same room at the hospital. One person is allowed to sit up for one hour every day during the screening to ventilate the lungs. His bed was next to the only window in the room. The other person must be included throughout the day. The two of them talked a lot to each other. They talked about their wives and children, their families, their homes, their jobs, their years in the army and even the vacations they had experienced.
One afternoon, when he sat up, the man by the window spent all his time describing to his roommate what he saw outside the window. The other person, every afternoon, waits to live in that one hour moment - the time when his world is vividly opened up by activities and colors outside.
The window overlooks a park with a lovely small lake. Ducks and geese played on the lake while children floated paper boats. Couples walking hand in hand among thousands of flowers and trying to brighten the afternoon. Lush old trees provide shade, and in the distance the city skyline appears.
As the man by the window describes in exquisite detail, the other person can close his eyes and imagine for himself a vivid picture. One afternoon, the man at the window described a parade passing by. Even though he couldn\'t hear the music, the other person still seemed to see it in his imagination through his roommate\'s story.
Day and night gradually pass....
One morning, when bringing bath water to their room, the nurse discovered that the man by the window had passed away peacefully in his sleep. She told her family to come and bring him home. One day, the remaining man asked to be moved next to the window. The nurse agreed to leave him alone. Slowly gathering strength, he stood up on his elbows and looked at the world outside. He strained to look out the window. Opposite the window is just a gray wall. He asked the nurse what had caused his miserable roommate to describe such wonderful things to him through the window. The nurse said that the man was blind and he couldn\'t even see the wall anymore.
“But maybe he wanted to encourage you to be more courageous,” she said.
Perfect heart

There was a young man standing in the middle of town and declaring that he had the most beautiful heart because there were no blemishes or cracks. The crowd agreed it was the most beautiful heart they had ever seen.

	 Suddenly an old man appeared and said: "Your heart is not as beautiful as mine!". The young man and the crowd looked at the old man's heart. It was beating strongly but was full of scars. There were parts of the heart that were removed and other pieces of the heart that were put in but did not fit tightly, creating a rough, jagged surface; There are also grooves missing without any heart pieces to replace them. The boy laughed and said: "You must be joking! My heart is perfect, but his heart is just a patchwork of scars and cuts. ”

	 – Each cut in my heart represents a person I love, not only girls but also parents, siblings, friends… I tear out a piece of my heart and give it to them, usually They will also give back a piece of their heart for me to cover where it was just torn out. But the pieces of my heart are not exactly the same, the piece of heart my parents gave me is larger than the piece of heart I gave them, in contrast to the pieces of my heart and my children's. Not equal, they create rough spots that I always cherish because they remind me of the love I shared. Sometimes I give pieces of my heart but never receive anything in return, they create defects. Love sometimes does not need reciprocity. Even though those flaws are painful, I always hope that one day they will give me back a piece of their heart, filling the void that I have always been waiting for.

	 The boy stood still with tears rolling down his cheeks. He stepped forward, tore a piece from his perfect heart and gave it to the old man. The old man also tore a piece from his heart full of traces and gave it to the young man. They fit but didn't quite match, creating a jagged line across the boy's heart. His heart is no longer perfect but it is more beautiful than ever because the old man's love flows in his heart…
Cup of salted coffee

He met her at a party. She is extremely pretty and cute… So many guys chase her while he is just a normal guy that no one pays attention to. At the end of the party, gathering all his courage, he invited her out for coffee. Very surprised, but out of politeness, she accepted.

	 They sat silently in a cafe. He was so shaken that he couldn't say a word. The girl started to feel bored and wanted to go home… The guy kept fiddling with the coffee cup, picking it up and putting it down… Just as the girl was about to stand up and ask permission to leave, the guy suddenly called out to someone. Waiter: "Please give me some salt in my cup of coffee." Almost everyone in the bar turned to look at him… The girl was also extremely surprised. She asked him why he had such a strange hobby. He was confused for a moment then said: "My house used to be near the sea. I really like playing with the ocean waves and the salty and bitter taste of sea water. Yes, salty and bitter - just like coffee with added salt… Every time I drink salted coffee like this, I miss my hometown and my parents so much…". The girl looked at him sympathetically and seemed very touched by his sincere feelings. She secretly thought that a person who loved his homeland and his parents like that must be a good person and would definitely be a good husband and father in the future… The story became more open when she also talked about her childhood and her parents. and my family…

	 When we broke up and left, we both felt very comfortable and happy. And through later dates, the girl realized more and more that the boy had many good qualities. He is very sincere, patient and always sympathizes with her difficulties. And… like every other story with a happy ending, the two got married. They lived very happily throughout their lives. Every morning before he went to work, she made him a cup of salted coffee…

	 But unlike fairy tales, this story doesn't stop there. Many years later, the couple grew old, and the husband was the one to pass away first… After he died, the wife found a letter he left behind. In the letter, it was written: “To the girl I love the most! There's something I didn't have the courage to tell you. I lied to you, only once in my life… Actually, the first day we met, talking to you was a joy for me. I was shaking so much when I sat across from you… At that time, I was about to order sugar for my cup of coffee, but I mistakenly said salt. Looking at your eyes at that moment, I knew I couldn't take back what I just said, so I made up a story about the sea and salt coffee. I don't like it at all and have never drank salted coffee before! So many times I wanted to tell you the truth but I was afraid… I promised myself that was the first and last time I lied to you. If I could do it all over again, I would still do it the same way… to have you and to drink the cup of salted coffee you make every day for the rest of my life… I love you!

	 The wife's eyes blurred when she read the last lines of the letter. She folded the letter and slowly stood up to make herself a cup of salted coffee… If anyone now asked her what salted coffee tasted like, she would tell them: It's very sweet!!!
Thousands of Paper Cranes

There are gifts that are simple but contain so much sincerity. I know a guy who folded 1,000 paper cranes to give to his lover. Even though at that time he was just an ordinary employee in the company, the future did not look bright, but they were always happy together. Then one day his lover said she was going to Paris and would never have the chance to see him again. She was very sorry, but eventually his pain would become a thing of the past. Let it sleep peacefully in everyone's memories.

	 The boy agreed but his heart was broken. He threw himself into work day and night, and finally founded his own company. Not only does it help him reach for the things that his lover had left him without before, it also helps him banish from his mind something of the old days.

	 One rainy day, while driving, the young man accidentally saw an old couple walking on the sidewalk under the same umbrella. The umbrella was not enough to cover them in the wind and rain. The boy immediately recognized that they were the girl's parents. The feelings he had previously had for them seemed to revive. He drove next to the old couple hoping they would recognize him. He wants them to see that he is no longer the same as before, that he can now create his own company, and can sit in a luxury car. Yes, it was him, the person their daughter had previously rejected, who had done it.

	 The old couple kept walking slowly towards the cemetery. Hastily, he got out of the car and chased after them. And he met his old lover again, still with the gentle, loving smile she once gave him, as if time had never changed that smile, gently looking at him from the portrait. on the tombstone. Next to her is his gift, the old paper cranes.

	 Only now did he know the truth: she never went to Paris. She had cancer and could not survive. She always believed that one day he would do many things, he would go very far on his career path. And she doesn't want to be an obstacle blocking his steps to his future. So she decided to distance him. She wished that her parents would place paper cranes on her grave, so that one day when fate brought him to meet her again, he could bring them back for company.
Angel wings

\n\n\n\t Once upon a time, a boy always had an inferiority complex because he had two very visible scars on his back. It extends from the shoulder blades down to the waist with wrinkled skin. Therefore, the boy always felt ashamed of himself.
Every day he went to school, he was afraid of being discovered by his friends. During gym class, when everyone was eager to change into a pure white gym shirt that wasn\'t soaked in sweat, the boy hid in a corner of the yard and quickly changed his shirt so that everyone couldn\'t see anything on his back.
A long time has passed, then whatever comes must come. “Oh, so disgusting!”, “Ah…monster!” , “oh, how terrible!” Those heartless words hurt our little friend\'s heart. He cried and ran into the classroom, avoiding everything. From then on, the boy never stepped out of class and especially he did not study physical education anymore.
After this incident, the boy\'s mother gently held his hand to meet the homeroom teacher. She is a kind female teacher. The mother said that when he was born, his son was seriously ill and almost lost all hope, but the family could not bear to abandon him and was determined to save the child. Through an extremely difficult surgery, the child was saved, but has since left two large scars on his back. Saying this, the mother trembled and burst into tears.
At gym time the next day, the boy appeared in a dark corner wearing a gym shirt. The other children saw that and innocently exclaimed heartless words: "Oh, that\'s scary!" , “…on his back there are 2 very big worms”. At that moment, the teacher accidentally passed by, the children surrounded her and talked about the scar.
The teacher approached the boy, gently placed her hand on his thin shoulder, smiled and said: "I was about to tell you a story before, but it seems I have to tell it right now." Young people surrounded her again. The teacher gently pulled up the boy\'s shirt, revealing two large scars. “This is a legend. Once upon a time, angels from heaven flew down and transformed into little people like us. Of course, there are agile angels who were able to remove their wings in time, but there are also angels who are a bit slow and could not remove their wings in time and left two marks like this."
“So those are angel wings?”
“That\'s right!” – the teacher smiled
Suddenly a girl spoke up: "Miss, can we touch them?" Since then, the boy has been standing there dumbfounded, crying again. She laughed again and said: "Do we have to ask our little angel\'s permission?" After being silent for a while, the boy regained his composure and replied: "Yes, okay!"
The little kids surrounded him, one after another touching those "wings". “Oh, it\'s great, I can feel the angel\'s wings!”.
As the years passed, our little friend became much older. He still silently thanked his teacher for giving him a new belief and a new energy. In high school, he boldly participated in the city-level swimming tournament and won runner-up. He bravely chose swimming because he believed that the scar on his back was a gift from his old teacher with all her love - angel wings.
Just a normal person

A mother took her two small children to her grandmother\'s house. They should also not be too quick to notice.
An officer holding a stack of books to go through. Lost in thought should take no notice.
The old lady used both hands to close the hem of her broken shirt. Stop and hide in a corner at the bus stop. An elegantly dressed gentleman also stood waiting for the bus. He tried to stand away from a little old lady. Of course, she\'s old and can\'t hurt anyone, but what if she gets infected…
A girl was also waiting for the bus. She kept glancing down at the old woman\'s feet, but said nothing. The bus arrived and the old lady walked heavily onto the bus. She sat in the seat right behind the driver.
The gentleman and the girl hurriedly ran to the back of the car to sit. The driver glanced at the old lady and thought: "I don\'t like seeing this poverty at all!".
A boy pointed at the old lady and exclaimed to his mother: – Mom, she\'s barefoot! Mom said only those who are bad go barefoot, right mom? The mother, a little embarrassed, pulled her child\'s hand down: - Andrew, don\'t point at others! Then the mother looked out the window.
– This old lady must have grown children! – a woman in a fur coat whispered – Her children should feel ashamed! This woman suddenly felt like she was a good person, because she always paid enough attention to her mother.
– See, everyone has to learn how to save money – a well-dressed guy added – If she knew how to save when she was young, she wouldn\'t be as poor as she is now!
A generous businessman suddenly felt embarrassed. He took out a $10 bill from his wallet, pressed it into the old woman\'s wrinkled hand, and said proudly: – Here, for you! Remember to buy a pair of shoes to wear! Then he returned to his seat, feeling satisfied and proud of himself.
The bus stopped when it reached the stop and a few passengers got on. Among them was a boy about 16-17 years old. He was wearing a big blue jacket and a big backpack, listening to headphones. He paid the bus fare and immediately sat on the same seat as the old lady. Then he saw the old woman walking barefoot. He turned off the music. Feeling cold. He looked from her legs to her feet Tools. He was wearing furry boots made for the snow. Brand new and warm shoes. He had to save his pocket money for a long time to buy it. All my friends compliment me!
But he bent down and began to take off his shoes and socks, then sat on the floor of the car, next to the old lady. – Grandma, I have shoes here! – He said. Carefully, he lifted the old woman\'s cold, shriveled feet and put socks and shoes on her feet. The old lady was stunned, just nodded slightly and said a very small thank you.

But the boy, who was pointing at the old woman, turned to his mother and said: – No, mom! I looked clear then that! He is a normal person! And that job, really, only requires an ordinary person.
A glass of milk

\n\n\n\t There was a poor boy selling street food in the residential areas to earn money to go to school. That day, he searched his pocket and only had a few coins left, but he was very hungry.
He decided to ask for a meal at a nearby house. He panicked when he saw a cute girl opening the door. Instead of begging for food, he asked for a glass of water. She thought he looked hungry so she brought him a large glass of milk.
He drank slowly, then asked: "How much do I owe you?"
The girl replied: “You don\'t owe me much. Mom taught us that we should never accept money for doing a good deed.”
He said: “Then I thank you very much.”
When Howard Kelly left that house, he not only felt healthy, but also felt very strong in his belief in people and in life.
After many years, that girl became seriously ill. Doctors in the area gave up and transferred her to the city center hospital so that experts could treat this dangerous disease. Dr. Howard Kelly was invited as an expert. When he heard the name of the patient\'s residence, a strange light flashed in his eyes. He stood up and went to the girl\'s room. He recognized the girl immediately. He returned to the specialist room and determined to do his best to save the girl. He paid special attention. After a long struggle, the girl\'s illness passed. He took the hospital bill, wrote something in the margin and had it delivered to the girl\'s room.
The girl was afraid to open the hospital bill, because she was sure that for the rest of her life, it would be difficult for her to pay the entire amount.
Finally she courageously looked, and noticed the words next to the bill: “Paid in full with a glass of milk.” (Sign) Dr. Howard Kelly.
Her eyes filled with tears, the girl emotionally exclaimed: "Lord, your immense love has spread in human hearts and hands."
How much does a miracle cost?

\n\n\n\t Tess was a wise eight-year-old when she heard her parents talking about her younger brother Andrew. He only knew that his younger brother was very sick and his family was out of money. They will have to move into a poor apartment next month because his father doesn\'t have enough money to pay the doctor and rent. Only an expensive surgery could save his life, and it seemed like no one was willing to lend his parents money. He heard his father whisper in a desperate voice to his sobbing mother: "Only a miracle can save his life now."
Tess went into her room and took out a glass jar of jam that she had previously hidden in the closet. He poured all the coins onto the floor and counted them carefully. It also counted all three times. The amount it has must be exact, there can be no mistakes. He carefully put the coins into the jar and closed the lid. He snuck out the back door and walked eight blocks to the Rexall Pharmacy with the Indian sign above the door.
It waited patiently to get the pharmacist\'s attention. But he was busy talking to another man and didn\'t want to be disturbed by an eight-year-old child. Tess rubbed her feet on the floor to make noise. No results. It strained its throat to make the loudest and most disgusting spitting sound. Still nothing happened. Finally he took a quarter from a glass jar and tapped it hard on the counter. This time there was a reaction!
"What do you want?" the pharmacist asked him in an annoyed voice. “I was talking to my younger brother from Chicago, whom I haven\'t seen in many years,” he said without waiting for an answer.
“As for me, I want to tell you about my brother,” Tess replied in an equally annoyed voice. “He is seriously ill…. and I want to buy a miracle”
“What are you talking about?” asked the pharmacist.
“His name is Andrew, he has something terrible growing in his head and my dad says only a miracle can save him now. Can you tell me how much a miracle costs?”
“Baby, we don\'t sell miracles here. I\'m sorry I couldn\'t help you.” The pharmacist said in a slightly softer voice.
“Hey man, I have money to buy it. If it\'s not enough, I\'ll make more. Please let me know how much it costs.”
The pharmacist\'s younger brother is an elegantly dressed man. He bent down and asked the boy, “What miracle does your brother need?”
“I don\'t know,” Tess answered through tears. “I just know he is seriously ill and needs surgery. But my dad doesn\'t have money to pay so I want to use my own money.” “So how much money do you have?” asked the man from Chicago.
“One dollar and eleven cents,” Tess answered weakly. “And this is all the money I have, but I\'ll make more if I need to.”
“Oh, what a coincidence,” the man smiled. “One dollar and eleven cents – that\'s the price of a miracle for your brother.” He took the money in one hand, and with the other he held the child\'s hand and said: "Please take me to where you live." I want to meet your brother and your parents. Let\'s see what miracle you need.”
That elegantly dressed man was Dr. Carlton Armstrong, a brain surgeon. The surgery was completed successfully and at no cost. Soon Andrew was released from the hospital and healthy. His parents happily recounted the story that led to this miraculous outcome. “That surgery was a miracle,” Tess\'s mother whispered. I don\'t know how much it actually costs?”
Tess smiled. He knows the exact price of a miracle… one dollar and eleven cents… plus the faith of a child

I called his cell phone. “The subscriber is currently unreachable.” I called the house, but no one answered. Why can it be? Could it be that the whole family had moved away without my knowledge? It was a friend of his cousin, in the same class as me. – How are you? Have you heard the news that Timmy is in the hospital? - Go to the hospital? What's going on? ., – In the hospital where you were last time… room number… I ran as fast as I could to the hospital. He lay on the bed, saying nothing, not moving. - What's going on? Why don't you call me? – I sat down next to the bed and cried, but he still didn't answer, just looked at me intently as always – Why didn't you say anything? I saw his eyes were wet, and he seemed to use all his strength to say: - I'm sorry… And he closed his eyes. – Hey, don't be like that… what are you sorry for? – I cried until I lost my voice – Don't apologize… Open your eyes… . I kept holding his sleeve and pulling, and couldn't stop crying. – Why apologize? Why do not you explain a word?
